lines.2: I was taking it easy after the exhaustion of the Sports and Martial Arts Festival.
lines.3: I lay on my bed devoting myself to reading--manga.
lines.5: ...Here she comes, the human bundle of energy.
lines.7: Otome sat down on my bed.
lines.8: This was bad. If I refused to exercise now, I was in perfect range for a joint lock.
lines.13: That should keep her occupied for a while.
lines.14: 「Hmm. A red thing you can bite into whole... three kana. What could it be?」
lines.15: Normally you'd think tomato or apple...
lines.16: 「Hmm. There are several possibilities, but... madai, maybe.」
lines.18: Once again, I was reminded how terrifying the Kurogane family could be.
lines.19: 「A weapon that produces extreme heat and burns a wide area all at once... six kana.」
lines.21: 「Hm. Could this mean the Kurogane-style secret art, 'Enma Hell'? My techniques really have become famous.」
lines.22: Yeah, this was going to take her a while to finish.
lines.23: And thus I achieved the heroic feat of lazing around even with Otome sitting right beside me.
